preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the setMaxWalletAmount function with a parameter that will cause maxWalletAmount to be set to zero. Since maxWalletAmount = _tTotal / _maxWalletAmountPct, passing a very large _maxWalletAmountPct (greater than _tTotal) will result in integer division yielding zero. This will effectively prevent any non-excluded wallet from holding any tokens, potentially causing a denial-of-service for regular users.
